name: next-step
description: Captures deterministic approval prompts and agent-declared next actions via lifecycle hooks and MCP, displaying at-a-glance session status (what is next, who acts, whether waiting on user) in a read-only HUD.
suggestedPrompts: 查看当前会话的下一步指令状态并打开 Next Step HUD
调用 next_step_get 检查是否有待处理的审批或下一步动作
使用 next_step_publish 显式发布当前任务的下一步执行计划
